title: Joint agency EEG dataset
description: This dataset contains behavioural and dual-EEG hyperscanning recordings from pairs of participants performing a musical joint action task. Pairs performed musical duets and constant pitch sequences on electronic music boxes and rated their sense of joint agency on each trial. The data support investigation of the cognitive and neural signals underlying joint agency, and include synchronization performance measures and event markers.
methods_description: Pairs of participants (32 pairs) each performed 8 tone sequences (4 musical duets and 4 constant pitch sequences), with 5 joint trials per sequence (40 test trials per pair). EEG was recorded simultaneously from both participants with 32 channels each and stored in BrainVision format. After each trial, participants rated joint agency on a 1-7 scale. Synchronization performance was computed from note onset asynchronies as a proportion of the inter-onset interval.
